content_sections.heading: About PDCCB
content_sections.text: The Prakasam District Cooperative Central Bank Ltd. (PDCCB), No. J. 551, is a district cooperative central bank. Its Central Office is on Governor Road, Ongole - 523001, Andhra Pradesh (Post Box No. 38). The Medical Officer will look after the bank's own active employees.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The engagement is on a contractual basis for one year. It does not give any right to permanent employment. The Management can select and appoint a suitable candidate, or cancel the engagement process at any stage, without giving a reason.

faq.question: Q1. Where will the PDCCB Medical Officer work?
faq.answer: At the bank's Central Office on Governor Road, Ongole, opposite the Head Post Office.

faq.question: Q2. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is a one-year contract and gives no right to permanent employment.

faq.question: Q3. How many hours a week is the job?
faq.answer: The doctor works 2 hours per visit, three working days a week.

faq.question: Q4. What will the Medical Officer do?
faq.answer: Give medical consultations, basic healthcare and medical advice, and certify medical bills of the bank's active employees.

faq.question: Q5. What registration do I need?
faq.answer: Registration from a state medical council, with a valid medical registration number. Send the medical registration certificate with your resume.

faq.question: Q6. Who should the resume be addressed to?
faq.answer: To the Chief Executive Officer, The Prakasam District Cooperative Central Bank Ltd., Ongole. The Chief Executive Officer signed the notification.

faq.question: Q7. Can the bank cancel this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes. The Management can cancel the engagement process at any stage without giving a reason.
